description.en: Payment details blur behind drifting pink and gold light, with floating particles and two processing steps before a crisp success state.
description.zh: 转账详情在粉金色光雾与上浮粒子后逐渐虚化，经过两段处理提示，再恢复为清晰的成功状态。

keywords: 转账 确认 弹窗 光雾 模糊 粒子 处理 成功 transfer confirm payment glow blur dialog Gabriel

discovery.caveat: 仅为本地视觉演示，不执行真实转账；处理完成可通过回调连接自己的业务。

source.implementation: Independently authored scoped DOM state machine, procedural Canvas2D light haze and particle renderer, with six native framework lifecycle wrappers. Local visual demo only.
source.license: Design reference by Gabriel; no author code or redistribution permission is claimed. Independently written DOM/Canvas2D implementation. Lucide icons retain ISC and embedded Inter retains OFL. Original clip and extracted frames remain internal.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Send to play the local confirmation, processing and success sequence. Close or press Escape to cancel; reopen from Convert to replay. No real payment is made.
instructions.zh: 点击发送，体验确认、处理与成功流程；关闭或按 Escape 取消，从 Convert 重新打开。仅为本地动效演示。
